title: Deployment Metric Contract Orchestrator
creator: Aisha Mercado
description:
Goal: Ship a policy engine that lets PMs/SEs declare "metric contracts" for staged deployments and automates pacing, guardrails, shadow probing, and hysteretic auto-rollback.

Background: Current canary primitives only support static step schedules and threshold checks. We need a richer expressivity for production rollouts: metric-level contracts (expected delta and acceptable bounds), stratified evaluation windows, adaptive step sizing based on metric trajectories, and a shadow/probe mode that mirrors a configurable fraction of traffic for behavioral checks without impacting user experience.

This ticket covers the orchestration layer and the contract specification surface (API + console) and an evaluation runtime that emits deterministic decisions (advance/hold/rollback) plus human-friendly rationales and a simulated outcome for proposed policies.
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /rollouts/v1/policies accepts a metric_contract JSON schema and returns a policy_id
Console: UI to create/edit metric_contracts with prefilled templates (latency, error_rate, quality-score) and show a simulated rollout preview
Engine: Runtime evaluates metric_contracts against streaming telemetry and emits deterministic 'step_decision' events every step window
Safety: Auto-rollback triggers when breach persists for configured hysteresis window; rollback includes reason and recent telemetry snapshot
Shadow: Ability to configure a shadow_probe fraction (0.1% - 20%) with separate metric baselining and drift detection
Observability: Per-policy dashboard with live traffic split, contract fulfillment chart, and audit log of automated actions
Integration tests: End-to-end simulation harness that validates statistical false positive rate < 2% for baseline traffic patterns
tech_notes: Metric contract model: list of metrics with comparator (delta_abs, delta_pct), direction (increase/decrease), tolerance, evaluation_window, aggregation (p50,p95,rate), and required_consecutive_windows
Evaluation approach: two-sample rolling comparison using bootstrapped CI + sequential p-value correction; default alpha=0.01 for safety-critical metrics, configurable per-policy
Pacing algorithm: thermodynamic-pacing — step size is a function of metric slope and variance. If slope < threshold and variance low => larger step, else conservative 1-2% step increments
Shadow probing: mirror traffic via 'probe token' path; sampling is stratified by route and region to ensure representative coverage
Telemetry sources: Prometheus (request latencies, QPS), Redwood runtime logs for model tokens/kv-cache hits, and e2e quality probes from eval harness

Implementation notes: keep decision runtime stateless where possible; store policy state and history in rollout-store (Postgres); evaluation workers pull windows from TS DB (Thanos/Prometheus) and write events to event-bus (Kafka) for the console and audit logs
Testing: build a synthetic traffic generator to replay production-like traffic with injected anomalies (spikes, skew, regen quality regressions) for policy validation
decisions: Use rolling 5m/30m windows by default; allow override per-metric in contract
Adopt conservative default thresholds: latency delta_pct <= 10%, error_rate delta_abs <= 0.05, quality-score delta_pct <= -2%
Auto-rollback requires 2 consecutive violating windows OR a single window surpassing 'catastrophic' threshold (configurable)
Expose both API-first JSON policy and Console editor; Console will show recommended policy based on historical telemetry
Separate 'canary' (gradual traffic shift) from 'shadow' (mirror-only) modes; both can be on for the same policy
policy_example:
# Example metric contract (YAML-like)
metrics:
  - name: request_latency_p95
    comparator: delta_pct
    direction: increase
    tolerance: 10
    aggregation: p95
    window: 5m
    required_consecutive: 2
  - name: error_rate
    comparator: delta_abs
    tolerance: 0.05
    aggregation: rate
    window: 5m
    catastrophic_threshold: 0.25
pacing:
  base_steps: [0.5, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50]
  adaptive: true
  slope_threshold: 0.02
shadow_probe:
  enabled: true
  fraction: 0.5
  stratify_by: [region, route]
rollback:
  hysteresis_windows: 2
  cooldown_minutes: 30
simulation_options:
  sample_traffic_profile: prod-weekday-1
  run_length_minutes: 120

Integrations: map telemetry queries to PromQL templates and create Thanos views for policy evaluation
E2E tests: add synthetic anomaly scenarios to CI that run against the simulation harness
